requirement.original: LaTeX rendering silently broken: MarkdownView.tsx has no case for latex block type, so LatexRenderer.tsx (fully implemented) is never invoked. LaTeX content parsed by parseMarkdown.ts as type latex falls through to null and is silently dropped.
requirement.clarified: Restore LaTeX rendering support that was removed in commit 1612a409. Both the $$...$$ parser in parseMarkdownBlock.ts AND the latex case branch + import in MarkdownView.tsx were stripped out. The type definition (parseMarkdown.ts) and renderer component (LatexRenderer.tsx) remain intact and need no changes.
requirement.what: Restore LaTeX $$...$$ block parsing and renderer wiring that were accidentally removed
requirement.why: LaTeX math content in messages is silently dropped -- users see nothing where formulas should appear

included: Restore $$...$$ parser in parseMarkdownBlock.ts (single-line and multi-line)
Restore latex case branch in MarkdownView.tsx renderContent()
excluded: Changes to parseMarkdown.ts type union (latex type already exists)

success_criteria: Single-line $$E = mc^2$$ renders as formatted math via KaTeX
Multi-line $$...\n...\n$$ blocks render as formatted math via KaTeX
yarn typecheck passes with no new errors
All existing block types (text, code, mermaid, tables, etc.) render identically
constraints: Must match original implementation from commit f8b208fa exactly
LaTeX parser must be placed before code-block parser in parseMarkdownBlock.ts
No changes to LatexRenderer.tsx or parseMarkdown.ts type definitions

root_cause_analysis.symptom: LaTeX content ($$...$$) in messages is silently dropped -- nothing renders where math formulas should appear
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Commit 1612a409 ('fix: 19 bug fixes from BUG-FIXES.md audit') accidentally removed three things: (1) the $$...$$ block parser from parseMarkdownBlock.ts, (2) the LatexRenderer import from MarkdownView.tsx, (3) the block.type === 'latex' case branch from MarkdownView.tsx renderContent(). Without the parser, $$...$$ lines fall through to text blocks. Without the case branch, even if parsed, latex blocks would return null.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 1612a409 - fix: 19 bug fixes from BUG-FIXES.md audit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Batch bug-fix commit that rewrote/modified MarkdownView.tsx and parseMarkdownBlock.ts to fix 19 other issues. The LaTeX code was collateral damage during the rewrite.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Complete feature removal disguised as bug fixes. The commit message gives no indication that LaTeX support was removed.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: LaTeX added in f8b208fa (2026-03-23), removed in 1612a409 (2026-03-26)

research_findings.reason: Straightforward regression fix -- restoring accidentally removed code from a known good commit
